title: Prove the acceptance evaluator end to end on one real task: build-bound pass, failed-build refusal, missing and stale evidence, evaluator failure
acceptance: On one real TermAl task with a criterion bound to Build, a host-recorded passing build followed by an independent evaluation completes the task through done, and the seal names that evaluation.

On the same kind of real task, each negative path retains its exact stage, typed refusal or host failure outcome and record IDs: failed Build, missing evidence, a stale evaluation after a later check, and an evaluator that fails or submits nothing; none permits done to complete on an inadmissible or older pass while the failed/unrecorded attempt remains pending.
The proof's record states which cases ran on real tasks and which on fixtures.
